name: Bombardiro Crocodilo: The Naked Clue
source:
Bombardiro Crocodilo: The Naked Clue is a visual novel where characters from the Italian Brainrot memes dive into a world of noir detective fiction, filled with absurd humor and ridiculous investigations. Alongside Bombardiro Crocodilo, Ballerina Cappuccina, and other iconic characters, you'll find yourself in an atmosphere of gritty streets, strange conspiracies, and unbelievable twists, where every step may lead to unpredictable consequences.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708740/]Steam[/url]]
